Mobile boat mechanics in Apollo Beach, Ruskin and Sun City Center, FL

South Hillsborough is lift country: miles of canals in Apollo Beach, MiraBay, and Symphony Isles, the Little Manatee River out of Ruskin, and the big public ramps at E.G. Simmons and Williams Park. Mobile service is the only kind that makes sense here.

Waters
  • Tampa Bay off Apollo Beach
  • Little Manatee River
  • Cockroach Bay and the south shore flats
  • Bullfrog Creek
Ramps and marinas
  • E.G. Simmons Park (Ruskin)
  • Williams Park (Riverview)
  • Cockroach Bay
  • Apollo Beach boat ramp (Apollo Beach Blvd)
  • Bahia Beach
Boats we see
Bay boats and center consoles on lifts, flats skiffs, pontoons, a growing number of larger offshore boats in MiraBay.

What breaks in Apollo Beach

  • Boats that sit on lifts through summer: fuel and battery no-starts in fall
  • Corrosion on engines a few feet above brackish canal water
  • Trailer failures on ramp boats from Sun City Center and Wimauma

Questions we get

Can you get to MiraBay and Symphony Isles?

Yes. Give the gate the mechanic's name when we text it to you.

I'm in Sun City Center with a trailer boat. Do you come there?

Yes, driveway service for trailer boats is routine.
